profile.visual_desc: Muscular human with a long dark blue ponytail and red headband. Wears grey armor padding, an orange tunic, grey boots, and a flowing dark blue cape.
profile.face_cutin_desc: Left-facing close-up. Stern, resolute expression with heavy shadowing over the eyes. Prominent red headband and thick blue hair framing a strong jawline.
profile.weapon_desc: Straight sword wielded in the right hand.
profile.step1_ready: Rear-isometric view facing up-left. Stands firmly with the right arm raised, holding the sword directed forward.
profile.step2_windup: Lunges into a deep forward crouch, thrusting the sword. Emits a massive golden energy cone that condenses into three beams.
profile.step3_impact: Holds the crouched lunge. Three distinct golden energy bolts detach and travel rapidly toward the top-left.
profile.step4_finish: Rises and pivots, drawing the sword back to the right. The cape swirls dramatically as he settles into a resting rear guard.
profile.kp7_slash_vfx_rule: Verify three distinct golden energy bolts traveling top-left in alignment with the low-crouch sword thrust.

evaluation.diagnosis: Animation maintains perspective and anatomical logic. VFX timing and alignment are consistent with reference.
